description: Source-linked rider-level EX observation store. No numerical EX records are included until a public, dated original is verified. Absent is not 0%.

metric_definitions.chigiri: Line leader separates an immediately following rider, numerator/eligible line-leader starts
metric_definitions.chigirarare: Line follower is dropped by the leader, numerator/eligible following starts
metric_definitions.kamashi: Successful kamashi attempts / observed kamashi attempts per source definition
metric_definitions.tsuppari: Successful tsuppari attempts / observed tsuppari attempts per source definition
metric_definitions.seri: Marker position kept in head-to-head contest / observed contest starts
metric_definitions.solo_win: Wins while racing solo / solo starts
metric_definitions.solo_top3: Top 3 finishes while racing solo / solo starts

note: Absence of a value means NOT_OBSERVED. This document is deliberately empty: public article defines EX metrics but does not enumerate each rider's actual counts. The adapter is active when valid official source-linked, date-bounded EX observations become available.
